moments.author: Eli Drinkwitz
moments.quote: “I just got a tweet…Looks like we’re ready to go…We wait for tweets from judges, man. What a system we’ve got here.”
moments.why: His humorous real‑time reaction to Sterling Webb being cleared to play went viral among college football and legal‑sports circles.

moments.author: OpenAI
moments.quote: We intend to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor, after its acquisition by SpaceX—access ends Nov 12.
moments.why: Massive tech‑developer buzz over OpenAI pulling access to its models from Cursor, a billion‑dollar customer, over trust issues with Musk’s companies.

moments.author: Cursor CEO Michael Truell
moments.quote: “Cursor was one of the very first users of OpenAI…we’ve trusted their platform to be neutral infrastructure.”
moments.why: His response gave voice to the developer community’s shock at OpenAI ending the partnership.

moments.author: OpenAI
moments.quote: We cannot be confident that SpaceX will use our technology within our terms of service, based on prior violations.
moments.why: Clarified the trust breakdown with Musk‑linked entities—this line sparked debate across AI and tech leader followings.
